name: z10-labs
description: Z10 Labs plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: deploy-monitor
plugins.description: Cloud routine that verifies every production deploy, traces failures to the PR and its authors, comments, opens an assigned issue, notifies Discord, Slack, Teams or any webhook, and opens a guarded draft fix PR. Config-driven per repo; Vercel, Fly, AWS Lambda and generic profiles; GitHub Actions variant included.
